name: io.github.funkyfunc/fearch
description: Respectful, corporate-safe, free web search and page reading for AI agents: honest identity, robots.txt, a human-in-the-loop browser tier, refusals as structured diagnoses, keyless official search.

packageArguments.name: --browser
packageArguments.description: auto | headless | headed | extension | off — auto (default): headless until a site shows a challenge, which then opens in a visible window for the person to pass (their own Chrome via the bridge extension preferred when connected; graceful where no display exists). With a person on call, Google joins DuckDuckGo. The other values pin one behaviour: never visible, always visible, extension only, or no browser tier.

packageArguments.name: --robots
packageArguments.description: default | strict | off — robots.txt for the tool's own fetching: user-initiated agent opt-outs (default), also training-crawler opt-outs (strict), or not consulted (off).

packageArguments.name: --engines
packageArguments.description: Engine result pages in preference order: google,bing,duckduckgo (default derived from --browser).

environmentVariables.name: FEARCH_UA_INFO_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL shown in the User-Agent (defaults to the project's bot-info page).

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: higher GitHub API limits and code search.
